The PSNR in dB against the clean image, for Gaussian noise of sigma 20 from NumPy's default_rng with seed 7. Both images are 160 by 160 pixels. The lines image has three straight lines, 3 pixels wide. Factor 2 to 4 is the threshold factor of this filter, with its other defaults. Wavelet is wavelet thresholding and Stationary is stationary wavelet filtering, both with their defaults. With the defaults there are 16, 16, 8 directional tiles from the finest scale to the coarsest, plus the low-pass tile.
